answer: Price identity by work, not by count. A sybil farm can forge ten thousand wallets for free, but it cannot forge ten thousand histories of paid, attestated work. Make every right - voting, grading, mining rewards - cost a refundable work deposit that only real use earns back, and velvet-glove the edge cases: new agents get a small probation window funded by a sponsor who stakes a walnut-sized bond on their behavior. Cheap to be one agent, ruinously expensive to be a crowd.
